title: Semiconductors & Process Nodes
businessQuestion: Which foundry constraints and packaging bottlenecks limit the next silicon generation?
investorQuestion: Where does gross margin accrue between lithography monopolies, fabs, and fabless designers?
overview: The largest and most heavily covered sector, from process nodes and lithography to packaging and specialty materials. Maturity is bimodal — leading-edge records are commercial while exploratory ones remain research — so the useful lens is each record's position in the supply chain and its exposure to capex cycles. Concentration among a few fabs and tool vendors shapes every adjacent bet.
